command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "foreach(`$n in @('AGG_SW_01','AGG_SW_02','AGG_SW_03','AGG_SW_04')){ Write-Output ('### '+`$n); `$base='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_08/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='; foreach(`$c in @('display current-configuration','display stp brief')){ `$x=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri (`$base+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c)); Write-Output ('## '+`$c); if(`$c -eq 'display current-configuration'){ (`$x.output -split "`n") | Where-Object {`$_ -match '^(sysname|stp |stp region| region-name| instance |interface | description| port link-type| port default vlan| port trunk allow-pass| undo port trunk| eth-trunk| mode lacp| shutdown| undo shutdown)' } } else { Write-Output `$x.output } } }"
